offering_description.value: Heartland Express hauls full truckloads of general freight for retailers, manufacturers and other commercial shippers. It uses its own tractor-trailer fleet and regional terminals to provide dry van and dedicated transportation, with carrier partners extending its cross-border reach.

primary_services.value: dry van truckload transportation; dedicated fleet services; temperature-controlled truckload transportation; freight brokerage

customer_segment.value: B2B: retailers, manufacturers, consumer goods companies and freight intermediaries

end_markets.value: retail; food and beverages; consumer packaged goods; industrial manufacturing; paper and packaging

revenue_model.value: service fees: freight hauling by load or mile, fuel surcharges and accessorial charges; project or contract: dedicated trucks and drivers for contracted shipping lanes

value_chain_position.value: service provider: takes full truckloads from commercial shippers and delivers them to distribution centers, stores and plants; asset operator: operates tractors, trailers and terminals to haul freight for commercial shippers

geography_served.value: North America: United States, with cross-border freight service to Canada and Mexico

specialization.value: related lines: dry van, dedicated and temperature-controlled trucking, plus freight brokerage

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: shipper contracts and national account relationships; partners / resellers: carrier partners for cross-border freight moves

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FMCSA motor carrier registration, hours-of-service rules, driver qualifications and vehicle safety standards

notes: The current scope of freight brokerage and temperature-controlled service is uncertain.
